evidence: Checked by reading and by parsing every TOML with tomllib (no cache files written). scoring.toml: `[gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0`, `[weights] functional = 0.6, polish = 0.2, visual = 0.2` (positive, sum 1.0), `[floors] functional = 0.05`; byte-identical to the frozen template scoring.toml, and each listed name has its directory in the right suite (tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional, tests/scored/polish, tests/scored/visual). All five judge.toml files: `[judge]` holds exactly judge="claude-code", mode="batched", timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md" plus mcp_servers; no model, reasoning_effort, temperature or weight key; top-level keys are only judge/scoring/criterion. The part of each judge.toml above the first [[criterion]] is diff-identical to the template's. Every dimension declares the playwright stdio server (`command = "playwright-mcp"`, args `--headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox`). Only scored/functional/judge.toml declares the second server: `name = "verifier"`, `command = "/usr/local/bin/python3"`, `args = ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]`; tests/test.sh generates the helper and runs `export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"` before run_suite, and restart_mcp.py reads `HELPER = sys.argv[1]` and exposes the single-use tool `restart_app`. test.sh, Dockerfile, .dockerignore, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template. Aggregation: gates `all_pass`, scored `weighted_mean`. Criteria: render 1, constraints 2 (all type binary, weight 1.0), functional 42 (binary, weights 1.0/1.5/2.0), polish 6 (binary, weight 1.0), visual 3 (likert, points = 5, weight 1.0, anchors 5..0 written); 54 ids, unique within each file and across files, id == name, no empty description, no unexpected criterion keys. These counts agree with the evidence index (3 gate, 42 Functional, 6 Polish). Prompts resolve: every dimension has prompt.md beside its judge.toml, each contains exactly the two placeholders `{app_context}` and `{criteria}` and no other brace; app_context.md contains no braces, so the test.sh substitution cannot introduce a stray placeholder; each prompt opens http://localhost:3000. Restart use is confined: only functional/prompt.md (`## Restart evidence`) and the one criterion cw_save_reload_restart (functional/judge.toml:339-345, `call the verifier-provided restart_app tool once`) refer to the tool, matching its single-use design. Budgets nest: gates 600 + 600 = 1200 < 1500; scored 9000 + 900 + 900 = 10800 < 11100; 1500 + 11100 = 12600 < task.toml `[verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0`; all unchanged from the template. Adversarial probes: a second restart caller, a likert or non-unit-typed gate criterion, a duplicated id, a weight in [judge], a prompt lacking {criteria}, and an unexpanded/misnamed helper variable were each looked for and none is present. Limitation: this is a source/parser review, not a run of the private check-rubric-schema.py / check-scoring-policy.py checkers, and no configured judge run exists for these bytes; the only hosted run is on an earlier candidate (ZIP eda58464) and is not a measurement of this candidate. The wiring files that determine runtime resolution are, however, unchanged template bytes.
